name: CelebA
description: Face attribute dataset with 40 binary attributes and facial landmarks across about 200,000 images. MMLAB research-only; loader-only. This is the parent attribute dataset, distinct from the CelebA spurious-correlation protocol already recorded. No data is vendored.
citation: Liu et al. (2015). CelebA: A Large-scale CelebFaces Attributes Dataset. IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
